codeStandard: Store ISO 639-1 where assigned; store ISO 639-3 for all 22 scheduled languages; do not pretend every language has a two-letter ISO 639-1 code.

fallbackSemantics.selectedLanguageUnavailable: use English UI bundle and expose fallback state
fallbackSemantics.selectedLanguageEnabled: use the selected language value when usable; otherwise fall back to the authoritative English catalog value for missing, empty, whitespace-only, or placeholder keys
fallbackSemantics.newLanguageEnabled: load its versioned locale bundle dynamically; no core-code language enum change required

userFacingStringPolicy: All UI labels, messages, statuses, placeholders, dialogs and feature text resolve through governed localization keys; source code literals are prohibited except technical identifiers, ARIA-required non-visible tokens and immutable brand/product names.
